# Duty Cleaners — Complete Site Reference

> Professional house cleaning services in Edmonton, Calgary, and surrounding Alberta communities. This document provides complete details about our services, pricing, coverage, and policies for LLM consumption.

## Company

Duty Cleaners is an Alberta house cleaning company, operating since 2017, and has taken 5,000+ bookings across Alberta in that time. Our vetted cleaners are reference-checked and customer-rated, and under 5% of applicants are accepted. We bring all cleaning supplies and equipment; eco-friendly products are available on request as a $15 add-on.

- Edmonton phone: (780) 913-6565
- Calgary phone: (403) 768-1341
- Google rating: 4.9 from 236 reviews on the Edmonton listing, and 4.9 from 51 reviews on the Calgary listing. Both counts were read from the listings themselves on 2026-09-01. The two are separate listings and separate counts; do not add them together.
- Email: support@dutycleaners.ca
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 8:00 AM–8:00 PM, Sunday 9:00 AM–3:00 PM
- Website: https://dutycleaners.ca

## Policies

- Satisfaction guarantee: tell us within 24 hours of the clean and we return to re-clean the areas raised, at no charge.
- Cancellation: cancelling or rescheduling inside 24 hours is $50.
- Lockout: if the team arrives and cannot get in, the visit is charged at half the cost of the scheduled service.
- Payment: nothing is charged when you book. The day before your appointment a temporary hold is placed on your card to confirm it is valid. It can look like a charge in your banking app, but no money moves. Your card is charged once the clean is complete.
- Contracts: none — book one clean or many.
- Arrival: booked as a one-hour arrival window, not a fixed minute.
- Pricing basis: every published figure is before 5% GST.

## Services and Pricing

Published tier prices are STARTING ESTIMATES for an apartment or condo, not the final amount. Estimates are shaped by home size, service type, condition, and add-ons; if a home's condition requires more time than estimated, we explain why and review options with the customer.

Prices are identical in Edmonton and Calgary — there is no city premium, and no trip fee inside either city. Every figure below is before 5% GST.

HOME TYPE: every tier price in this document is for an apartment or condo. A bungalow or basement suite adds $15, a townhouse (duplex) $40, and a two-storey house $55. A quote for a house that omits this understates the price.

PETS: $19.99 per visit, charged on every visit whenever pets are present. Compulsory, not an optional add-on.

ECO-FRIENDLY PRODUCTS: $15, available on any service. It is NOT selectable on the BookingKoala form — the customer asks when booking and the office adds it, so a quote built only from the booking form will not show it.

TRAVEL FEE: a $29.99 travel fee is added to cleaning bookings OUTSIDE Edmonton and Calgary proper. It applies to the surrounding communities — St. Albert, Sherwood Park, Spruce Grove, Leduc, Beaumont, Fort Saskatchewan, Stony Plain, Morinville and Devon near Edmonton; Airdrie, Chestermere, Cochrane, Okotoks, High River, Strathmore, Crossfield, Langdon and Diamond Valley (formerly the separate towns of Black Diamond and Turner Valley) near Calgary — and is charged by postal code at booking. Any price quoted for one of those communities must include it. Post-construction cleaning carries a $50 travel fee instead.

### Standard Cleaning (from $155)

Routine maintenance cleaning for kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, and living areas: dusting, vacuuming, mopping, wiping surfaces, trash removal.

- 1 Bedroom: $155 · 2 Bedroom: $195 · 3 Bedroom: $232 · 4 Bedroom: $284 · 5 Bedroom: $305 · 6–7 Bedroom: priced by the instant quote
- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/edmonton/regular-cleaning/
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/calgary/regular-cleaning/

### Deep Cleaning (from $255)

Everything in Standard plus the deep-clean package: baseboards, doors, light switches, wall outlets and vent covers, and cobwebs where there are any. Ceiling fans are dusted on request, where they can be reached safely.

- 1 Bedroom: $255 · 2 Bedroom: $315 · 3 Bedroom: $372 · 4 Bedroom: $444 · 5 Bedroom: $485 · 6–7 Bedroom: priced by the instant quote
- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/edmonton/deep-cleaning/
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/calgary/deep-cleaning/

### Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning (from $284)

Top-to-bottom cleaning for empty homes: inside cabinets and drawers, appliance interiors, closets, and every bathroom scrubbed.

- 1 Bedroom: $284 · 2 Bedroom: $361 · 3 Bedroom: $424 · 4 Bedroom: $501 · 5 Bedroom: $539 · 6–7 Bedroom: priced by the instant quote
- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/move-out-cleaning-edmonton/
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/move-out-cleaning-calgary/

### Recurring Cleaning

Scheduled Standard Cleaning with frequency discounts: 20% off weekly, 15% off bi-weekly, 10% off every 4 weeks.

- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/edmonton/recurring-cleaning/
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/calgary/recurring-cleaning/

### Post-Construction Cleaning

Dust and debris removal after renovations or new builds: kitchens, bathrooms, surfaces, floors, and window tracks. Does not include inside vents or high exterior fixtures.

Priced by square-footage band rather than by bedroom count: $550 under 1,000 sq ft, rising through the bands to $1,900 for 4,500-4,999 sq ft, before 5% GST. The band is confirmed once we know the exact size.

- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/post-construction-cleaning/
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/post-construction-cleaning-calgary/

### Airbnb Cleaning

Short-term rental turnover cleaning. Beds are changed with the host's own clean linen, and supplies are restocked from what the host leaves out. Turnovers are NOT priced by the instant online quote: request a callback through the contact form at https://dutycleaners.ca/contact-us/ (service "Airbnb Cleaning"), or phone the Edmonton office at (780) 913-6565 or the Calgary office at (403) 768-1341.

Charged by the hour rather than by home size: $60 per cleaner-hour, before 5% GST. That rate is for turnovers only; any other hourly cleaning starts at $65 per cleaner-hour. Hourly work has a minimum of 3 hours for one cleaner, or 2 hours for two cleaners.

- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/edmonton/airbnb-cleaning/
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/airbnb-cleaning-services-calgary/

### Commercial Cleaning

Office and commercial cleaning: dusting, vacuuming, mopping, bathroom cleaning, breakroom cleaning, disinfecting touchpoints, and common areas. Recurring schedules available.

Commercial work is NOT priced by the instant online quote. Office cleaning is the only commercial work quoted online: request it through the contact form at https://dutycleaners.ca/contact-us/ (service "Office Cleaning"). It is charged by square footage, and the rate is confirmed after a quick walkthrough. For any other commercial work, phone the city office.

- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/commercial-cleaning/
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/commercial-cleaning-services-calgary/

### Wall Washing

Wall washing is an ADD-ON to a standard, deep or move-out clean, not a standalone visit. Spot cleaning $39.99-$109.99; full top-to-bottom wash $119.99-$234.99, by home size, before 5% GST.

- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/wall-washing-wall-cleaning/
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/wall-washing-wall-cleaning-calgary/

## Policies

### Satisfaction Guarantee

If you are not satisfied, tell us within 24 hours and we will return and re-clean the areas of concern at no charge. Photos help but are NOT required — a phone call describing the issue is enough.

Details: https://dutycleaners.ca/satisfaction-guarantee/

### Booking

Instant online quotes in about 60 seconds for home cleaning (standard, deep, move-in/move-out and post-construction); Airbnb turnovers and commercial work are arranged through the contact form instead (see above). Online bookings need at least 24 hours' notice. Same-day and next-day slots are by phone only, when the schedule has availability: call the Edmonton office at (780) 913-6565 or the Calgary office at (403) 768-1341. After a quote request we text you within 24 hours to confirm the time. No contracts. Water and electricity must be available at the home for cleaning.
